_comment: WS C2 model roles (PLAN 4.4). roles: autoresearch backend:model specs (llm.get_llm). petri: Inspect model ids for harness/petri/run_audits.py. The dev target is an open reasoning model served by harness/modal_vllm.py (raw chain of thought for A1); point OPENAI_COMPAT_BASE_URL at it. Final mode swaps in the held-out target and judges, which the loop never optimises against (PLAN I7). Check with: python3 -m autoresearch.research.models_config

env.OPENAI_COMPAT_BASE_URL: the Modal URL printed by `modal deploy harness/modal_vllm.py`, plus /v1
env.OPENAI_COMPAT_API_KEY: the VLLM_API_KEY you put in the Modal secret
env.MODAL_BASE_URL / MODAL_API_KEY: the same two values, for Inspect's openai-api/modal/... ids in the Petri harness
